info.title: Recipe Finder API
info.description: Find recipes you can cook with the ingredients you have.

get.description: Ranks the whole catalog against the comma-separated ingredients the user has, counting pantry staples (salt, pepper, water, olive oil) as always available. Recipes with the fewest missing ingredients come first; ties are broken by most matched ingredients. The result is paginated over the ranked list. Running the search without at least one usable ingredient is rejected with 422.

parameters.name: ingredients
parameters.description: Comma-separated ingredient names the user has; case and plural forms are normalized

parameters.name: readyToCookOnly
parameters.description: Keep only recipes with no missing ingredient (ready to cook right away)

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page index over the ranked matches

200.description: Successful response with the operation payload
